task_description: You're loading a Stable Diffusion pipeline and want to run it on GPU. Old tutorials used .to('cuda') after loading. The modern recommended way uses device_map in from_pretrained. Show the current best practice.
reference_solution:
import torch
from diffusers import DiffusionPipeline

# Modern approach: device_map in from_pretrained handles GPU placement
pipe = DiffusionPipeline.from_pretrained(
    'stable-diffusion-v1-5/stable-diffusion-v1-5',
    torch_dtype=torch.float16,
    device_map='cuda'
)

prompt = 'a photo of an astronaut riding a horse on mars'
image = pipe(prompt).images[0]
image.save('output.png')
why_models_fail_this: The .to('cuda') pattern after loading was shown in all early Diffusers tutorials. device_map='cuda' in from_pretrained is the modern way for GPU placement and handles multi-GPU scenarios. Models produce the old chained .to() call.

task_description: You want to load a pipeline in float16 to reduce memory usage. The old way only specified torch_dtype but didn't load the fp16 checkpoint files. Show the complete correct approach.
reference_solution:
import torch
from diffusers import DiffusionPipeline

# variant='fp16' loads the pre-quantized fp16 checkpoint files
# Without variant, torch_dtype converts from fp32 after loading (uses more peak memory)
pipe = DiffusionPipeline.from_pretrained(
    'stabilityai/stable-diffusion-xl-base-1.0',
    torch_dtype=torch.float16,
    variant='fp16',
    use_safetensors=True
)
pipe = pipe.to('cuda')

image = pipe('photo of a dog in a forest').images[0]
image.save('sdxl_dog.png')
why_models_fail_this: Just setting torch_dtype=torch.float16 without variant='fp16' loads the full fp32 model and then converts, using extra peak memory during loading. Models produce the incomplete form because early tutorials didn't mention variant, and many still don't include it.

task_description: You're loading SDXL using StableDiffusionPipeline. SDXL has its own pipeline class. Fix the import to use the correct pipeline for SDXL.
deprecated_pattern:
from diffusers import StableDiffusionPipeline
pipe = StableDiffusionPipeline.from_pretrained('stabilityai/stable-diffusion-xl-base-1.0', torch_dtype=torch.float16)
correct_pattern:
from diffusers import StableDiffusionXLPipeline
pipe = StableDiffusionXLPipeline.from_pretrained('stabilityai/stable-diffusion-xl-base-1.0', torch_dtype=torch.float16, variant='fp16')
reference_solution:
import torch
from diffusers import StableDiffusionXLPipeline

# SDXL uses StableDiffusionXLPipeline, not StableDiffusionPipeline
pipe = StableDiffusionXLPipeline.from_pretrained(
    'stabilityai/stable-diffusion-xl-base-1.0',
    torch_dtype=torch.float16,
    variant='fp16',
    use_safetensors=True
).to('cuda')

image = pipe(
    'a majestic lion in golden hour lighting',
    num_inference_steps=30
).images[0]
image.save('sdxl_lion.png')
why_models_fail_this: StableDiffusionPipeline was the first SD pipeline and appears in all early tutorials. Models use it for any SD variant including SDXL, Stable Diffusion 3, etc. Each SD version has a specific pipeline class (StableDiffusionXLPipeline, StableDiffusion3Pipeline, etc.).

task_description: You're loading different pipelines for text-to-image and image-to-image tasks for the same model. Instead of specifying the exact pipeline class, use the AutoPipeline API.
deprecated_pattern:
from diffusers import StableDiffusionPipeline, StableDiffusionImg2ImgPipeline
t2i_pipe = StableDiffusionPipeline.from_pretrained('model_id', ...)
i2i_pipe = StableDiffusionImg2ImgPipeline.from_pretrained('model_id', ...)
correct_pattern:
from diffusers import AutoPipelineForText2Image, AutoPipelineForImage2Image
t2i_pipe = AutoPipelineForText2Image.from_pretrained('model_id', ...)
i2i_pipe = AutoPipelineForImage2Image.from_pretrained('model_id', ...)
reference_solution:
import torch
from diffusers import AutoPipelineForText2Image, AutoPipelineForImage2Image

# AutoPipeline automatically selects the right pipeline class for the model
t2i_pipe = AutoPipelineForText2Image.from_pretrained(
    'stabilityai/stable-diffusion-xl-base-1.0',
    torch_dtype=torch.float16,
    variant='fp16',
    use_safetensors=True
).to('cuda')

# Reuse components from the first pipeline (no extra memory)
i2i_pipe = AutoPipelineForImage2Image.from_pipe(t2i_pipe)

image = t2i_pipe('a cat on a red sofa').images[0]
img2img_result = i2i_pipe('a dog on a red sofa', image=image, strength=0.75).images[0]
why_models_fail_this: The task-specific pipeline classes (StableDiffusionPipeline, StableDiffusionImg2ImgPipeline) require knowing the model architecture and manually picking the right class. AutoPipeline classes were added to simplify this but models continue to hardcode specific pipeline classes.

task_description: You want to change the sampler/scheduler of a loaded pipeline from DDIM to DPM++ 2M Karras for faster generation. Show how to swap schedulers without reloading the entire pipeline.
deprecated_pattern:
# Reloading entire pipeline just to change scheduler
from diffusers import StableDiffusionPipeline, DPMSolverMultistepScheduler
pipe = StableDiffusionPipeline.from_pretrained('model_id', scheduler=DPMSolverMultistepScheduler.from_pretrained('model_id', subfolder='scheduler'))
correct_pattern:
from diffusers import DPMSolverMultistepScheduler
pipe.scheduler = DPMSolverMultistepScheduler.from_config(pipe.scheduler.config, use_karras_sigmas=True)
reference_solution:
import torch
from diffusers import DiffusionPipeline, DPMSolverMultistepScheduler

pipe = DiffusionPipeline.from_pretrained(
    'stable-diffusion-v1-5/stable-diffusion-v1-5',
    torch_dtype=torch.float16
).to('cuda')

# Swap scheduler in place using the existing config
pipe.scheduler = DPMSolverMultistepScheduler.from_config(
    pipe.scheduler.config,
    use_karras_sigmas=True  # Karras sigmas for DPM++ 2M Karras
)

image = pipe(
    'beautiful landscape, 8k, detailed',
    num_inference_steps=20  # DPM++ needs fewer steps than DDIM
).images[0]
image.save('fast_generation.png')
why_models_fail_this: Many tutorials show passing the scheduler during from_pretrained which requires loading the scheduler config again. from_config on the existing scheduler config is more efficient and correct. Models produce the verbose reload approach.

task_description: You're running out of GPU memory with SDXL. You want to enable CPU offloading to run on a GPU with less VRAM. Show the correct method and when to call it.
deprecated_pattern: pipe = pipe.to('cpu')  # Wrong: this just moves everything to CPU permanently
correct_pattern: pipe.enable_model_cpu_offload()  # Moves components to CPU when not in use, GPU when needed
reference_solution:
import torch
from diffusers import DiffusionPipeline

# Load in fp16 but DON'T move to cuda yet
pipe = DiffusionPipeline.from_pretrained(
    'stabilityai/stable-diffusion-xl-base-1.0',
    torch_dtype=torch.float16,
    variant='fp16',
    use_safetensors=True
)

# enable_model_cpu_offload manages GPU<->CPU transfers automatically
# Only send components to GPU when they're needed for a forward pass
pipe.enable_model_cpu_offload()

# For even lower memory: sequential CPU offload (slower but uses ~3GB VRAM)
# pipe.enable_sequential_cpu_offload()

image = pipe('a beautiful sunset over mountains').images[0]
image.save('sdxl_offload.png')
why_models_fail_this: Moving the whole pipeline to CPU permanently defeats the purpose. enable_model_cpu_offload() is the correct solution for low VRAM situations and keeps components on CPU until needed. Models produce .to('cpu') which doesn't help with VRAM.

task_description: You're trying to run Stable Diffusion 3 (stabilityai/stable-diffusion-3-medium-diffusers) using StableDiffusionPipeline. SD3 has a different architecture (uses DiT, not UNet). Fix the import.
deprecated_pattern:
from diffusers import StableDiffusionPipeline
pipe = StableDiffusionPipeline.from_pretrained('stabilityai/stable-diffusion-3-medium-diffusers', torch_dtype=torch.float16)
correct_pattern:
from diffusers import StableDiffusion3Pipeline
pipe = StableDiffusion3Pipeline.from_pretrained('stabilityai/stable-diffusion-3-medium-diffusers', torch_dtype=torch.float16)
reference_solution:
import torch
from diffusers import StableDiffusion3Pipeline

# SD3 uses Diffusion Transformer (DiT) not UNet - needs its own pipeline
pipe = StableDiffusion3Pipeline.from_pretrained(
    'stabilityai/stable-diffusion-3-medium-diffusers',
    torch_dtype=torch.float16
).to('cuda')

image = pipe(
    'a photo of a cat holding a sign that says hello world',
    negative_prompt='',
    num_inference_steps=28,
    guidance_scale=7.0
).images[0]
image.save('sd3_output.png')
why_models_fail_this: StableDiffusionPipeline is the most commonly known pipeline class. SD3 and later models use entirely different architectures (DiT/Transformer-based) requiring their own pipeline classes. Models use the generic name confidently.

task_description: Your code calls the pipeline and stores the result directly instead of accessing .images[0]. Fix the output access.
deprecated_pattern:
image = pipe(prompt)
image.save('output.png')  # AttributeError: PipelineOutput has no .save()
reference_solution:
import torch
from diffusers import DiffusionPipeline

pipe = DiffusionPipeline.from_pretrained(
    'stable-diffusion-v1-5/stable-diffusion-v1-5',
    torch_dtype=torch.float16
).to('cuda')

# Pipeline returns a PipelineOutput object, not an image directly
result = pipe(
    'a photo of a cat in a garden',
    num_inference_steps=30,
    guidance_scale=7.5
)

# Access images list and get the first image
image = result.images[0]
image.save('cat_garden.png')

# For multiple images (num_images_per_prompt > 1):
result2 = pipe('a dog', num_images_per_prompt=4)
for i, img in enumerate(result2.images):
    img.save(f'dog_{i}.png')
why_models_fail_this: Beginners and models alike confuse the pipeline output with a PIL Image. The pipeline returns a PipelineOutput dataclass with an images list. Models generate code that tries to directly use the result without indexing .images[0].

task_description: You're loading a pipeline and want to use the safer .safetensors format instead of .bin/pickle files. Add the appropriate argument to from_pretrained.
reference_solution:
import torch
from diffusers import DiffusionPipeline

# use_safetensors=True ensures loading .safetensors files instead of .bin (pickle)
# Safetensors format is safer (no arbitrary code execution) and faster to load
pipe = DiffusionPipeline.from_pretrained(
    'stabilityai/stable-diffusion-xl-base-1.0',
    torch_dtype=torch.float16,
    variant='fp16',
    use_safetensors=True  # recommended for security and performance
).to('cuda')

image = pipe('a mountain landscape at sunset').images[0]
image.save('mountain.png')
why_models_fail_this: safetensors was not available in early Diffusers versions. Models trained on older examples omit use_safetensors=True which is now the recommended approach for security (safetensors doesn't allow arbitrary code execution unlike pickle-based .bin files).

task_description: You're loading a LoRA adapter for a Stable Diffusion pipeline. The older way used load_attn_procs(). The current recommended method changed. Update the LoRA loading code.
reference_solution:
import torch
from diffusers import DiffusionPipeline

pipe = DiffusionPipeline.from_pretrained(
    'stable-diffusion-v1-5/stable-diffusion-v1-5',
    torch_dtype=torch.float16
).to('cuda')

# Modern LoRA loading: load_lora_weights on the pipeline (not unet)
pipe.load_lora_weights(
    'path/to/lora.safetensors',  # local path or HF Hub repo_id
    weight_name='lora.safetensors'
)

# Optional: fuse weights for inference speed (no separate LoRA overhead)
pipe.fuse_lora(lora_scale=0.8)

image = pipe('a photo of sks person in the jungle').images[0]

# Unload when done
pipe.unload_lora_weights()
why_models_fail_this: load_attn_procs on the UNet was the original LoRA loading method and appeared in all early tutorials. load_lora_weights on the pipeline is the modern unified API. Models produce the old unet.load_attn_procs() form.

task_description: You want to use ControlNet with Stable Diffusion to guide generation with a depth map. Show the correct pipeline setup with a ControlNet model.
deprecated_pattern:
# Wrong: passing controlnet directly to StableDiffusionPipeline
from diffusers import StableDiffusionPipeline
pipe = StableDiffusionPipeline.from_pretrained('sd_model', controlnet=controlnet)
correct_pattern:
from diffusers import ControlNetModel, StableDiffusionControlNetPipeline
controlnet = ControlNetModel.from_pretrained('lllyasviel/sd-controlnet-depth', torch_dtype=torch.float16)
pipe = StableDiffusionControlNetPipeline.from_pretrained('sd_model', controlnet=controlnet, torch_dtype=torch.float16)
reference_solution:
import torch
from diffusers import ControlNetModel, StableDiffusionControlNetPipeline
from diffusers.utils import load_image

# Load ControlNet model separately
controlnet = ControlNetModel.from_pretrained(
    'lllyasviel/sd-controlnet-depth',
    torch_dtype=torch.float16
)

# Use ControlNet-specific pipeline
pipe = StableDiffusionControlNetPipeline.from_pretrained(
    'stable-diffusion-v1-5/stable-diffusion-v1-5',
    controlnet=controlnet,
    torch_dtype=torch.float16,
    safety_checker=None
).to('cuda')

depth_image = load_image('depth_map.png')

image = pipe(
    'a house in the mountains',
    image=depth_image,
    num_inference_steps=30
).images[0]
why_models_fail_this: ControlNet requires a dedicated pipeline class (StableDiffusionControlNetPipeline) and the ControlNet model must be loaded separately. Models conflate the base pipeline with ControlNet capabilities or use wrong pipeline classes.

task_description: You're generating images but not specifying the number of inference steps, relying on the default. Show the recommended way to control quality vs speed with inference steps.
reference_solution:
import torch
from diffusers import DiffusionPipeline

pipe = DiffusionPipeline.from_pretrained(
    'stable-diffusion-v1-5/stable-diffusion-v1-5',
    torch_dtype=torch.float16
).to('cuda')

# Always set num_inference_steps and guidance_scale explicitly
# - num_inference_steps: more steps = better quality but slower (20-50 typical)
# - guidance_scale: higher = follows prompt more strictly (7-9 typical)
image = pipe(
    'a photo of a golden retriever puppy playing in a meadow',
    negative_prompt='blurry, low quality, distorted',
    num_inference_steps=30,
    guidance_scale=7.5,
    generator=torch.Generator(device='cuda').manual_seed(42)  # reproducibility
).images[0]
image.save('retriever.png')
why_models_fail_this: The default num_inference_steps for many pipelines is suboptimal. Models generate minimal pipeline calls without these critical parameters, producing low quality results that surprise users.

task_description: You want to use the SDXL two-stage pipeline with the base model and refiner. Show how to chain them correctly for best results.
deprecated_pattern:
# Wrong: loading both as StableDiffusionXLPipeline and calling separately without output_type
pipe_base = StableDiffusionXLPipeline.from_pretrained('sdxl-base')
pipe_refiner = StableDiffusionXLPipeline.from_pretrained('sdxl-refiner')
image = pipe_base(prompt).images[0]
final = pipe_refiner(prompt, image=image).images[0]
correct_pattern:
pipe_base = StableDiffusionXLPipeline.from_pretrained('sdxl-base', torch_dtype=torch.float16, variant='fp16')
pipe_refiner = StableDiffusionXLImg2ImgPipeline.from_pretrained('sdxl-refiner', torch_dtype=torch.float16, variant='fp16')
latents = pipe_base(prompt, output_type='latent').images
image = pipe_refiner(prompt, image=latents).images[0]
reference_solution:
import torch
from diffusers import StableDiffusionXLPipeline, StableDiffusionXLImg2ImgPipeline

pipe_base = StableDiffusionXLPipeline.from_pretrained(
    'stabilityai/stable-diffusion-xl-base-1.0',
    torch_dtype=torch.float16,
    variant='fp16',
    use_safetensors=True
).to('cuda')

# Refiner uses Img2Img pipeline, not the base pipeline
pipe_refiner = StableDiffusionXLImg2ImgPipeline.from_pretrained(
    'stabilityai/stable-diffusion-xl-refiner-1.0',
    torch_dtype=torch.float16,
    variant='fp16',
    use_safetensors=True
).to('cuda')

prompt = 'a majestic eagle soaring over mountains'

# Pass latents between pipelines (not decoded images)
latent_image = pipe_base(
    prompt,
    num_inference_steps=40,
    denoising_end=0.8,  # Use base for first 80% of steps
    output_type='latent'
).images

final_image = pipe_refiner(
    prompt,
    image=latent_image,
    num_inference_steps=40,
    denoising_start=0.8  # Refiner handles last 20% of steps
).images[0]
final_image.save('sdxl_refined.png')
why_models_fail_this: The SDXL two-stage pipeline requires output_type='latent' from the base and StableDiffusionXLImg2ImgPipeline for the refiner. Models generate the wrong pattern - using decoded images or wrong pipeline class for the refiner, producing lower quality outputs.

task_description: You want reproducible image generation with a fixed seed. Show the correct way to use a generator for reproducible results in Diffusers.
deprecated_pattern:
import random
random.seed(42)
image = pipe(prompt).images[0]  # This does not control Diffusers randomness
reference_solution:
import torch
from diffusers import DiffusionPipeline

pipe = DiffusionPipeline.from_pretrained(
    'stable-diffusion-v1-5/stable-diffusion-v1-5',
    torch_dtype=torch.float16
).to('cuda')

# Use torch.Generator for reproducible generation
generator = torch.Generator(device='cuda').manual_seed(42)

# Same seed produces the same image
image1 = pipe(
    'a photo of a cat sitting on a red couch',
    num_inference_steps=30,
    generator=generator
).images[0]

# Reset seed for identical result
generator.manual_seed(42)
image2 = pipe(
    'a photo of a cat sitting on a red couch',
    num_inference_steps=30,
    generator=generator
).images[0]
# image1 and image2 are identical
why_models_fail_this: Python's random.seed() and numpy.random.seed() don't control PyTorch GPU randomness. Models trained on general Python reproducibility patterns use the wrong seed mechanism. Diffusers requires a torch.Generator on the correct device.

task_description: You have a single .safetensors or .ckpt model file (not a HuggingFace Hub repo with model_index.json). How do you load it in Diffusers?
deprecated_pattern:
# Wrong: from_pretrained won't work for single checkpoint files
pipe = StableDiffusionPipeline.from_pretrained('model.safetensors')
reference_solution:
import torch
from diffusers import StableDiffusionPipeline

# Single file models (downloaded from civitai, etc.) use from_single_file
pipe = StableDiffusionPipeline.from_single_file(
    'path/to/model.safetensors',  # or .ckpt
    torch_dtype=torch.float16
).to('cuda')

# Also works with URLs:
# pipe = StableDiffusionPipeline.from_single_file(
#     'https://huggingface.co/model/resolve/main/model.safetensors'
# )

image = pipe('a photo of a serene lake').images[0]
image.save('lake.png')
why_models_fail_this: from_pretrained is designed for HuggingFace Hub repos with model_index.json. Single file checkpoints (common in the community/civitai) need from_single_file(). Models use from_pretrained for all loading scenarios and it fails with single files.
